title: Rethinking Reward Model Evaluation Through the Lens of Reward Overoptimization
reasoning: The paper includes a substantive section (Section 6) and appendix material (Figures 14 and 15) dedicated to benchmarking the 'safety' domain. This involves evaluating reward models based on their ability to handle harmful content and determine the appropriateness of refusals, which falls under the evaluation of ethics and moral alignment in AI responses.
